title: The new board and tech views show only this organization and location
custom_preconds:
1. Two organizations/workplaces on the Work Orders QA build, and a user in organization A only.
  2. Seed / setup: work orders, lead technicians and manual orders belonging to organization B; and a technician id that belongs to organization B.
custom_steps:
1. As the organization-A user, try to load organization B's Board View / Tech View data by its addresses.
  2. Attempt a reassignment supplying a technician id that belongs to organization B.
  3. Note for the tester: server-side scoping and the organization-ownership check are developer/automated checks. By hand, confirm only that no organization-B data or technician is ever shown or accepted.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every new Board View / Tech View query is scoped by both workplace and organization; a user in another organization or workplace cannot read the data.
  • An inbound technician id on a reassignment gets an organization-ownership check, so a technician from another organization is refused (eligibility remains the picker's job).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders - Board View & Tech View); Work Orders Board View & Tech View Display Options Technical Implementation Plan (engineering tech plan .md, provided 2026-09-30), section 1.4 Clarifications; read 30 Sep 2026. Specified by the tech plan / Product clarification and not covered by the PRD stories.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • NFR-006: “Every new query is scoped by workplace and organization.”
  • Clarification - Tenant check on inbound technician id: “Add organization-ownership check (eligibility stays the picker's job per the PRD).”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - server-side scoping is a developer/automated check; the two-org observation is manual, not yet build-verified on the Work Orders QA build
